description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. SUPPLIER DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER, FLUID SYSTEMS (LAUNCH SITE)

SpaceX demands a new type of supply chain. We require our suppliers to provide premium quality with rapidly evolving designs at increasingly ambitious volumes. We are actively looking for candidates who possess comprehensive knowledge of manufacturing and quality tools and have an unrelenting motivation to enable suppliers to succeed. This position will be the key focal point for fluid systems on Starship launch infrastructure and ground support equipment, and requires a combination of proven leadership and technical capabilities. 

This is a highly technical position that requires practical experience in process engineering and new product introduction through stabilized production for fluid-system equipment and piping used on Starship launch infrastructure and ground support equipment. The ideal candidate will have a broad understanding of pumps, valves, regulators, welded piping, and packaged cryogenic systems for gaseous and liquid methane, oxygen, and nitrogen, with the desire and capability to take on new challenges in unfamiliar areas to help enable our mission to Mars. 

RESPONSIBILITIES: 

  • Act as the technical point of contact for assigned fluid-system equipment, piping, and packaged systems within flight, non-flight, and launch-site and recovery infrastructure, solving emergent challenges at suppliers and mitigating risk to the manifest by addressing high-impact manufacturing, fabrication, and quality issues
  • Lead and coordinate containment activities for pumps, valves, regulators, skids, and welded piping to protect build, activation, and launch schedules, and drive ongoing reliability improvements in the fluid-systems supply base
  • Intervene and drive resolution at the supplier for critical-path cryogenic and gas-system hardware (including liquid and gaseous methane, oxygen, and nitrogen service) to ensure zero disruption to site construction, activation, and operations
  • Review issues on assigned equipment and systems and solve to the root cause, implementing changes at the supplier, at SpaceX, or both; drive further actions to closure; and re-source to new suppliers where appropriate
  • Create and disposition issue tickets where needed, working with engineering counterparts on rework, repair, or use-as-is, including weld repairs, cleanliness, leak, and functional nonconformances
  • Become thoroughly familiar with assigned pumps, valves, regulators, heat exchangers, tanks, skids, and the welding and piping processes that make up the overall fluid system, and become the primary point of contact for supply-chain-related defects on those products
  • Work with procurement to find and qualify suppliers of cryogenic and industrial-gas equipment (pumps, valves, regulators, vaporizers, piping, and packaged systems) and vet them for quality, cleanliness, weld capability, and ability to meet aggressive takt times
  • Conduct design-for-manufacturing and design-for-fabrication reviews of fluid equipment and piping so products are manufacturable and inspectable early, preferably prior to sourcing, including materials compatibility, weld joint design, and clean-build requirements for oxygen and methane service
  • Own the new product introduction process at the supplier for new equipment, drawing and specification changes, or when re-sourcing existing fluid-system hardware
  • Drive production part approval (or an equivalent equipment qualification package: weld procedures, NDE, hydro/pneumatic test, leak test, cleanliness, and functional test) to stabilize supply, reduce inspection oversight, and improve delivery
  • Support supplier process audits covering welding (procedure and performance qualification), piping fabrication, machining of wetted components, assembly, cleaning, and test for LOX, LCH4/GCH4, LN2/GN2, and GOX service
  • Demonstrate innovation, technical excellence, attention to detail, self-direction, and the courage to push the technical envelope conventionally held in the industry
  • Drive for results and customer satisfaction by collaborating with launch-site engineering, operations, and procurement, leading projects, and continuously improving the fluid-systems supply base 

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in an engineering or STEM discipline 
  • 5+ years of experience with manufacturing and/or inspection of mechanical products in a production environment 

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCES: 

  • Master’s degree in mechanical, chemical, materials, welding, or a related engineering discipline
  • Experience with fluid-system equipment used in cryogenic or high-purity gas service, including centrifugal and reciprocating pumps, cryogenic pumps, valves, regulators, relief devices, and packaged skids
  • Experience with welded piping systems and pressure equipment: pipe and fitting fabrication, orbital and manual welding, fit-up, hydrotest and pneumatic test, and installation of gaseous and liquid methane, oxygen, and nitrogen systems
  • Working knowledge of welding codes and practices applicable to process piping and pressure equipment (for example ASME B31.3, ASME Section IX, and AWS), including WPS/PQR review, welder qualification, and NDE (VT, PT, RT, UT as applicable)
  • Familiarity with oxygen-service and cryogenic materials, cleaning, and contamination control (for example oxygen compatibility, passivation, and particle/NVR cleanliness) and with seals, seats, and lubricants used in LOX, GOX, LCH4, and LN2
  • Experience interpreting P&IDs, piping isometrics, equipment datasheets, and engineering drawings and models, including GD&T on machined valve, regulator, and pump components
  • Experience with vendor-engineered products and the commercial suppliers of this class of hardware (cryogenic pumps, valves, vaporizers, and piping packages)
  • Working knowledge of supplier quality processes (production part approval, advanced product quality planning, first article or factory acceptance test, inspection and test plans)
  • Knowledge of statistical techniques and methods (design of experiments, Lean, Six Sigma) applied to fabrication, weld quality, leak, and functional performance
  • Experience with quality systems (ISO 9001, AS9100, and pressure-equipment or welding quality programs) and manufacturing systems (MRP/ERP)
  • Working knowledge of problem-solving techniques such as 8D or A3
  • Proficient in MS Office and Excel and in report writing
  • Proficient in SQL and Power BI
  • Experience sharing information and influencing others across organizational lines, internally and at suppliers, including on the shop floor and at vendor factories 

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: 

  • Must be able to travel - up to 60-85% work week travel may be required, including international travel 
  • Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to meet major milestones 
  • Valid driver’s license 

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
